row.team_price_text: Contact Sales (DocuWare says Cloud typically costs $30 to $125+ per user per month)
row.evidence: DocuWare's Knowledge Center says DocuWare Cloud User Provisioning uses SCIM, and its API guide describes a SCIM 2.0 compliant service for Entra ID, Okta, Ping and generic IdPs; pricing is quote-only ("Your DocuWare rep will work with you to build a solution").
row.notes: Quote-only: DocuWare publishes no plan table, only that Cloud has four standard tiers and typically costs $30 to $125+ per user per month; tier names and which tier includes User Provisioning are not public. SCIM (User Provisioning v3) is documented for DocuWare Cloud (Entra ID, Okta, PingOne, generic IdPs, on-prem AD via a connector) and on-premises 7.13+. Entra and Okta are set up as custom (non-gallery / custom SAML+SCIM) apps, not catalogue apps. SCIM DELETE is a soft delete that deactivates the user; group DELETE is not supported. SSO is OIDC (Entra ID etc.) under Configuration > Security and is not a prerequisite for SCIM (Okta setup uses a placeholder SAML app only to unlock provisioning). A non-SCIM Platform API exposes user, group and role endpoints. The legacy User Synchronization desktop app is being retired in favour of User Provisioning.

plans.name: DocuWare Cloud (four unnamed standard tiers)
plans.price_text: Typically $30 to $125+ per user per month; quote via sales or partner
plans.notes: Tier names and per-tier features are not published.

auth.token_source: DocuWare Configuration > General > User Provisioning: create an Application Registration (client ID + secret); Entra can also use a generated Bearer token
auth.notes: JWT bearer tokens with scope docuware.userProvisioning; Entra supports OAuth2 client-credentials grant or a bearer token; Okta uses OAuth 2 authorization flow.

endpoints.notes: Endpoint table also lists GET /AvailabilityCheck (unauthenticated health check).

operations.notes: Reactivation inferred from PATCH replace on the active attribute (documented path). DELETE /Users is a soft delete (deactivation).

deprovision.data_retained: User is marked disabled and can no longer log in; DELETE is a soft delete.
deprovision.notes: The on-premises licence page says a deleted or disabled user's named client licence can be reassigned; Cloud licensing behaviour is not documented.

attributes.notes: The enterprise extension schema must be declared but no enterprise attributes are documented as mapped.

limitations.text: DELETE on Groups is not supported.
PATCH remove is not supported for users.
Filtering supports only userName eq / externalId eq (users) and displayName eq (groups).
For non-generic IdPs the userName is stored without the email domain.
Configuring User Provisioning requires the Organization Administrator role.

fallbacks.other_sync: User Provisioning On-Premises connector syncs on-prem Active Directory/OpenLDAP to DocuWare over SCIM; legacy User Synchronization desktop app (being retired)
fallbacks.notes: SSO can auto-link existing users at first login; account creation on SSO login is not documented.
